newsitem.title: PERU: Peru delays auction of electric companies.
newsitem.headline: Peru delays auction of electric companies.

text.p: The Peruvian government said Tuesday it was delaying its scheduled July 22 auction of two electricity-generating companies, which seven foreign firms are interested in, until August 26.
"Many bidders have asked for more time to prepare their offers, so the new date is August 26," said electricity privatization official Felipe Repetto.
The government is auctioning 60 percent of electrical generators Egasa and Egesur, both in southern Peru.
"There are seven companies interested in participating in the bid," Repetto told Reuters. "They are American and Belgian, and two have associations with Peruvian companies."
The government has also postponed its Electro Norte generator from July 31 to September 2.
Peru has received $1.69 billion from electricity sell-offs, and $240 million in investment commitments, since beginning the privatization of that sector in 1994.
